name: llm-proxy-on-cloudflare-workers
description: A serverless proxy on Cloudflare Workers for multiple LLM APIs with unified authentication and key rotation.
author: blue.pen5805

scripts.dev: tsx scripts/with-secrets.ts --env develop -- cf dev --mode develop
scripts.tsc: npm run cf-typegen && tsc --noEmit && npm run test:types
scripts.verify: npm run tsc && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage

PROXY_API_KEY.description: Required. Generate a strong, unique value used to authenticate requests to the proxy.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Your [OpenAI API key](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys). Configure at least one provider key.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Your [Google AI Studio API key](https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey). Configure at least one provider key.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. Your [Anthropic API key](https://platform.claude.com/settings/keys). Configure at least one provider key.
